identity.fantasy: A ghostly skirmisher who moves through Deathchaser and Limbo states, marks a Gravesite, and lets Soulrot and shades mature before the spectral payoff.
identity.one_line: A ghostly skirmisher who moves through Deathchaser and Limbo states, marks a Gravesite, and lets Soulrot and shades mature before the spectral payoff. The defining decision is contextual: The player must choose when to remain spectral, cash delayed damage, or reset.

mechanics.core_loop: A ghostly skirmisher using Deathchaser, Soulrend, Dirge, Wraithblade, shades, Limbo, and delayed Soulrot. It moves in and out of spectral states, marks an area as a Gravesite, and rewards managing Reaped Souls and debuff timing.

modes.name: Shade
modes.structural_description: Become a shade, entering an improved stealth mode for 10 seconds and entering Underwalk. Removes all movement impairing effects.

modes.name: Soulrot
modes.structural_description: Damage dealt by Deathchaser now applies Soulrot.SoulrotRot the soul of your target, cursing them for 15 seconds. At the end of the duration the enemy will take damage based on the number of stacks accrued. Each instance of damage from Deathchaser adds 1 stack to this effect, up to 20 stacks. Dispelling this effect causes the dispeller to instantly take 1200 + 200% AP Shadow Damage.

mechanics.single_target: Play as a spectral burst skirmisher: establish Gravesite and Reaped Souls, align Soulrot and Limbo, then disengage or reset. The only captured build says to play like Subtlety Rogue without Shadow Dance and gives no exact button order.
mechanics.aoe: Shades, Gravesite, and spectral effects provide area pressure, but current sources focus on PvP burst-reset play and do not establish a dungeon pack rotation.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Spectral states create high mobility and reset potential with corresponding positional demands.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Lamenting, Chasing Death, The Jailer's Call, Spiritual Reflexes, Endbringer.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Spectre, Death's Presence, Soulrot.

failure_modes.text: Leaving Gravesite, entering Limbo at the wrong time, or consuming Reaped Souls before delayed effects mature wastes a setup that may not be recoverable immediately.
